items.title: La Real se carga al 'SuperBarça', que vuelve a perder en Zubieta un año después (2-1)
items.description: Qué victoria de la Real Sociedad, la nueva bestia negra del 'SuperBarça', en Zubieta. Las txuri urdin lograron una victoria épica, de muchísimo mérito, absolutamente merecida, para tumbar al coco, que no perdía un partido desde hacía casi un año, precisamente en Zubieta también. Historia, por segunda vez. Remontaron, además, el gol del primer minuto de Guijarro con dos golazos de Cecilia y Ainhoa Marín. Con hasta siete guipuzcoanas en el campo por momentos. Segunda victoria consecutiva de la Real, que sale del descenso, logra su primer triunfo liguero en casa del curso y se arma de moral y confianza tras un partidazo en el día más complicado.

items.title: FC Barcelone
items.description: Le FC Barcelone, ou Barça, est un club de football espagnol fondé en 1899, situé en Catalogne. L'équipe, surnommée Blaugrana, évolue au Camp Nou, stade de près de 100.000 places. A son palmarès, 26 titres de champion d'Espagne, 31 Coupes du roi, cinq Ligues des champions notamment. Xavi est l'entraîneur du Barça depuis 2021. Parmi les joueurs phares de l'histoire du club: Lionel Messi, Andres Iniesta, Ronaldinho ou encore Johan Cruyff.

items.title: Wigan pine for FA Cup glory as not even victory can lift them off foot of League One
items.description: Gary Caldwell, club captain in 2013 and now manager, needs much more than Saturday’s win over Reading to disperse the cloudsIf the 2013 FA Cup final represented a blip for the Sheikh Mansour-era Manchester City in their quest for total domination of English football, it was a historic moment for their conquerors, Wigan Athletic. Memories of that famous day at Wembley still endure for Latics’ supporters despite the relegation from the Premier League that followed. Yet watching the modern-day Wigan, who remain bottom of League One despite a 1-0 win over Reading on Saturday, makes the toppling of City in a Cup final seem an epoch ago.The club, perhaps understandably, continue to hark back to their halcyon days. Last season they brought back Gary Caldwell – club captain in 2013 – for his second stint as manager, having led the club to promotion from this division in 2015-16. Choosing to swap Exeter for a return to the Latics was seen as a risky move by Caldwell, considering the shoestring budget imposed upon him by Mike Danson, the owner who is keen to sell. It was a Sunday night in the second division, they lost 3-0 against Badajoz, and he didn’t enjoy it much.But then, he never enjoys it much. Even on Tuesday at Anfield, he will not: into his 30th year, the longest presidency in Europe, that is about the only thing that hasn’t changed. items.title: El Celta busca oxígeno y el Alavés romper su mala racha
items.description: Todavía sin digerir el golpe que supuso perder ante la Juventus en el alargue, el Celta recibe este domingo al Alavés en Balaídos, donde hace cinco meses Quique Sánchez Flores celebró su primera victoria como técnico vitoriano tras la épica remontada de su equipo, que levantó un 3-0 en la segunda parte.

items.title: El Barça quiere más en Liga F
items.description: El impecable Barça de Pere Romeu retoma la Liga F Moeve (12 h/DAZN/ Vamos Movistar +) visitando a la Real Sociedad en la séptima jornada. Las azulgranas, imparables, regresan a la competición después del parón de selecciones y de firmar una goleada histórica ante el Real Madrid (7-0). Con todo, el técnico culé, Pere Romeu, reivindicó cuidar la “memoria corta” para evitar despistes. “Lo que hemos hecho hasta ahora está muy bien, pero el fútbol va de repetirlo al día siguiente”, señaló Romeu.

items.title: Cinco partidos para concluir la jornada en el grupo 2 de Primera Federación
items.description: Duelo competitivo e importante para los intereses de ambas formaciones, que atraviesan una complicada dinámica y quieren instalarse, como mínimo, en la zona cómoda de la clasificación. Además, se trata de un envite entre dos equipos que llegan al enfrentamiento después de ver cómo sus respectivos rivales de la semana pasada les quitaban el triunfo cuando ya lo saboreaban.

items.title: Aura de aspirante
items.description: Adía de hoy, no hay en Europa un equipo que juegue tan bien como el Barça de Flick. Ninguno marca tanto, ninguno divierte más. Su fútbol ofensivo es una delicia para el aficionado y su pegada ya no impresiona, empieza a resultar insultante. Pero conviene no confundir el brillo con la corona. En la Champions, el Barça sigue siendo el aspirante. El rey vive en París y se llama PSG de Luis Enrique.

items.title: El Andorra examina la regularidad del Girona
items.description: El Girona regresa a Montilivi con la necesidad de romper una racha de dos citas sin lograr la victoria. Después de encadenar dos empates frente al Mallorca y el Tenerife, los de Quique Álvarez reciben (18:30 horas) al Andorra con el objetivo de recuperar un triunfo que les permita acercarse a las posiciones de ascenso directo. Los blanc-i-vermells suman 15 puntos en nueve jornadas y siguen buscando la regularidad necesaria para consolidar su candidatura al regreso a Primera.

items.title: El Barça, un arsenal de goles y de goleadores
items.description: Con y sin Raphinha, el Barça está en ‘modo goleador’ aplastante. En los 11 partidos oficiales disputados, las 9 jornadas de Liga y el par de partidos de la Champions League, el equipo azulgrana ha anotado 48 goles, a una media de 4,3 goles por partido. Lleva cinco manitas (Elche, Rayo, Valencia, Feyennord y Betis) y siete tantos le cayeron al Racing. Sólo en LaLiga van 39, una veintena más que el segundo, el Atlético. Eric Garcia, Rodri y Olmo se apuntaron a semejante festival con su primer tanto. Para el madrileño fue, incluso, el primero de culé.

items.title: Las previas de los seis duelos de domingo en el grupo 2 de Segunda Federación
items.description: El Estadi Municipal de Reus acoge al mediodía una cita de alta intensidad entre dos formaciones que llegan al alza. El equipo dirigido por Sergio García, con un partido menos, está en la parte alta de la tabla y suma dos victorias consecutivas, demostrando una versión muy superior a la de su contrincante pese a la juventud de su plantilla. Por su parte, el Reus FC Reddis, que se mantiene cerca de la zona de promoción de ascenso, viene de doblegar de forma contundente al Tudelano a domicilio y regresa a su feudo, donde no gana desde hace un mes (dos partidos).

items.title: Arrasate vuelve a El Sadar para recuperar la ilusión de Osasuna ante el Racing
items.description: Osasuna se mide al Racing de Santander (14:00 horas) con el regreso de Jagoba Arrasate al banquillo navarro como principal novedad y el objetivo de poner fin a la mala racha ante unos cántabros que no jugaban en Pamplona desde el año 2014 y que acumulan una mala racha a domicilio

items.title: Derbi en Alcalá, ante el equipo revelación en el arranque de temporada
items.description: El Atlético de Madrid Femenino tiene por delante una complicada cita, este domingo 18 de octubre (18.00 horas), recibe en la Ciudad Deportiva de Alcalá, al equipo que está siendo la revelación de la liga en este arranque, el Madrid CFF.

items.title: Serios problemas en ataque
items.description: El Athletic sigue sin ganar. Al igual que ocurrió en los dos partidos anteriores ante Elche y Alavés, el equipo se tuvo que conformar con sumar un punto en Mestalla, un resultado justo a tenor de los méritos hechos por uno y otro equipo. Los leones fueron mejores en la primera mitad, aunque sin ocasiones claras. La única fue un disparo de Iñaki Williams al filo del descanso que obligó a Dimitrievski a realizar una buena intervención. El Valencia mejoró tras el paso por los vestuarios, cuando tuvo que aparecer el de siempre, Unai Simón.

items.title: "Viva el Betis manque pierda"
items.description: Este es uno de los gritos de ánimo más famosos del fútbol español. Se hizo muy popular coincidiendo con el descenso en 1947 del equipo verdiblanco a la Tercera División, en la que estaría durante siete temporadas. Durante todo este tiempo se mantuvo intacta la fidelidad de los béticos hacia su equipo, que estaba muy por encima de los resultados. Años más tarde, en su canción “Caminito de la obra”, Joan Manuel Serrat ponía de manifiesto a ritmo de rumba lo que significó para muchos de los andaluces que emigraron en masa a Catalunya durante la década de los sesenta el fervor compartido entre Barça y Betis. “!Que gane el Barça en casa y el Betis fuera!”, tarareaba el “noi del Poble Sec” en una de las estrofas de la canción.

items.title: Continúa la jornada en el grupo 5 de Tercera Federación con ocho encuentros
items.description: El Pobla Mafumet llegará más descansada que su rival, ya que el L’Hospitalet disputó entre semana el partido que tenía aplazado con triunfo sobre el Mollerussa. La formación de Xavi Vilagut, tras ganar al Cornellà la pasada jornada por la mínima, acusa las ausencias de Joel Sánchez y Manu Pavón, mientras que el equipo de Raúl Paje, que jugará su segundo choque consecutivo en casa, tiene a Boris Garrós y Jairo Morillas en la enfermería. Manel es duda.

items.title: Examen de jerarquía para la Real Sociedad ante un Málaga colista y en horas bajas
items.description: Esto no para. La Real Sociedad vuelve a la escena. El conjunto dirigido por Pellegrino Matarazzo afronta hoy un nuevo envite liguero en un estadio que echaba de menos la Primera División. El Málaga recibe a las 18:30 a la Real Sociedad en un duelo entre dos escuadras míticas de la máxima categoría del fútbol español, que llegan en dinámicas totalmente contrarias a un encuentro con un favorito, aunque con muchos más kilómetros en las piernas para los futbolistas del conjunto txuri urdin.

items.title: De Burgos acertó al anular el gol
items.description: Con su inconfundible forma de arbitrar, De Burgos dirigió dialogando mucho con los futbolistas en un encuentro intenso en que se esforzó físicamente para estar cerca de la jugada y en que consiguió dar mucha fluidez al juego al aplicar en numerosas ocasiones la ventaja.

items.title: Gianni Infantino under fire again as FIFA insiders reveal new details of USMNT’s Folarin Balogun red card saga at 2026 World Cup
items.description:
Gianni Infantino is facing renewed scrutiny over FIFA’s handling of Folarin Balogun’s controversial red card at the 2026 World Cup, with fresh allegations raising questions about how the decision was reversed. 
Gianni Infantino is facing renewed scrutiny over FIFA’s handling of Folarin Balogun’s controversial red card at the 2026 World Cup, with fresh allegations raising questions about how the decision was reversed. The controversy has returned to the spotlight just as the FIFA president faces growing opposition ahead of next year’s election, creating another difficult moment for soccer’s governing body.



Balogun was sent off while representing the United States against Bosnia and Herzegovina during the 2026 World Cup, triggering an automatic one-match suspension that threatened to rule him out of the round-of-16 clash with Belgium. However, FIFA’s disciplinary panel subsequently suspended the ban, allowing the forward to play in the United States’ 4-1 defeat to Belgium.



The unusual decision attracted criticism from European soccer officials, who questioned whether FIFA had applied its disciplinary rules consistently. The controversy intensified after reports emerged that US President Donald Trump had contacted Infantino about the punishment.



New allegations raise questions about FIFA’s decision



According to The New York Post, four sources briefed on the matter alleged that Infantino agreed to ensure Balogun’s suspension was overturned following a phone call with Trump on July 1. “He told President Trump that he would take care of it. One call and it was done,” one source told The New York Post.









FIFA has denied that its position has changed in response to unnamed sources, with a spokesperson telling the newspaper: “Our position has not changed regardless of what unnamed sources claim.” The spokesperson did not address the specific allegation about what Infantino told Trump during their conversation.



Proposed rule changes add another twist



The latest reporting also points to a proposed change to FIFA’s disciplinary regulations that would prevent legal panels from suspending automatic one-match bans following red cards. Documents reviewed by The New York Post reportedly indicate that FIFA circulated the draft amendment shortly before a high-stakes council meeting in Zurich.



Folarin Balogun #20 of the United States reacts to receiving a red card



An internal briefing document reportedly stated: “There was never a doubt nor lack of clarity on how the automatic suspension following a red card is to be served.” The document allegedly described the proposed change as a way for FIFA to address the handling of the Balogun case, although FIFA’s stated justification was to protect the stability and integrity of competitions.



Historical FIFA directives dating back to 2002, 2003 and 2005 reportedly allowed mandatory suspensions to be waived only when a referee had mistakenly identified the player who should receive a card. Those documents could become significant as officials examine whether the original decision followed established procedures.

items.title: Christian Pulisic on edge as Ruben Amorim set to make surprise selection decision ahead of Milan’s crucial Serie A clash vs Atalanta
items.description:
Pulisic’s place in the starting lineup has become one of the biggest talking points ahead of the encounter. 
Christian Pulisic faces an uncertain afternoon as Ruben Amorim prepares Milan for a crucial Serie A meeting with Atalanta at San Siro. After a convincing European victory restored some confidence, the Milan manager must decide which players deserve to retain their places as the club enters a demanding run of three matches in one week.



Milan hosts Atalanta on Sunday, October 18, hoping to maintain its strong league form and overcome a difficult recent record against its Lombardy rival. However, Pulisic’s place in the starting lineup has become one of the biggest talking points ahead of the encounter.



The Rossoneri head into the match after dismantling Salzburg 4-0 in the Europa League, with Alphadjo Cisse scoring a hat-trick before Goncalo Ramos added a fourth goal. The result provided a welcome response after criticism of the team’s performances and gave Amorim several selection decisions to consider. The Red and Blacks must now transfer that momentum into Serie A, particularly after drawing 1-1 with Sassuolo in its previous league fixture.



Atalanta also won in Europe during midweek, defeating Pafos 3-1 in the Conference League. Maurizio Sarri’s side has experienced an inconsistent Serie A campaign, collecting three wins and three defeats from its opening six matches, but it recently returned to winning ways against Venezia.





p



Pulisic faces an uncertain role



Pulisic has struggled to maintain momentum in recent appearances, with an underwhelming display against Sassuolo followed by approximately 30 minutes off the bench against Salzburg. His goal against Lecce before the international break had appeared to offer a fresh start, but he now faces renewed uncertainty over his role.



The American international had been expected to support Ramos in attack against Atalanta. However, Sky Italia, indicates that Amorim has been experimenting with a starting formation that leaves Pulisic out of the team.



Christian Pulisic of AC Milan reacts



Where does Pulisic belong in Amorim’s attacking combination?



Pulisic is expected to start on the bench against Atalanta, with Amorim reportedly considering Adrien Rabiot in an advanced attacking midfield role alongside Cisse. The potential change would allow Yunus Musah and Luka Modric to partner centrally, while Diego Moreira and Samuel Chukwueze provide width.



The decision would represent a significant change for the America n, although the congested schedule could give him another opportunity soon. Milan faces Bournemouth in the Europa League before returning to domestic action against Udinese, making squad rotation an important consideration.

items.title: Raphinha and Lamine Yamal join Lionel Messi in elite Barcelona club after impressive start to LaLiga season
items.description:
Lionel Messi’s name keeps appearing in the Barcelona record books, and this time it is two of his successors who have pushed their way into a very exclusive list. Raphinha and Lamine Yamal are enjoying a remarkable start to the LaLiga season, and their numbers are already comparable to some of the best in the […] 
Lionel Messi’s name keeps appearing in the Barcelona record books, and this time it is two of his successors who have pushed their way into a very exclusive list. Raphinha and Lamine Yamal are enjoying a remarkable start to the LaLiga season, and their numbers are already comparable to some of the best in the club’s history.



Barcelona beat Real Betis 5-2 in LaLiga Matchday 9, with a brilliant performance from Yamal, who contributed a goal and an assist to the win and made history alongside Raphinha.



According to statistician Mister Chip, Raphinha and Yamal have each been directly involved in 13 or more goals in Barcelona’s first nine LaLiga matches of the 2026-27 season. Raphinha has 12 goals and three assists, for 15 goal contributions, while Yamal reached 13, with eight goals and five assists, after his strike against Betis.



Yamal then climbed to 14 when he set up Gabriel Jesus for his goal, a result that gave Barcelona their ninth straight league victory to start the season. Only one other team had done it before: Real Madrid in 1968-69, which makes Hansi Flick’s side the second in LaLiga history to open a campaign with nine consecutive wins.




Perfect record intact. 💯 pic.twitter.com/ahG2157NSl— FC Barcelona (@FCBarcelona) October 17, 2026




The feat has been achieved before by only a handful of Barcelona players: Messi did it four times, in 2011-12, 2012-13, 2014-15 and 2017-18, while Cesar Rodriguez did it three times, Eulogio Martinez twice, and Mariano Martin, Estanislau Basora and Ronaldo once each.


        


Yamal makes LaLiga history among under-20 players



Yamal’s start to the season has also put him in a category of his own. According to Mister Chip, the Barcelona winger is the under-20 player with the most direct goal contributions in the first nine rounds of a season in LaLiga history. His 14 contributions, from eight goals and six assists, are three more than the previous best.



Jose Iraragorri held the previous mark with 11 contributions for Athletic Club in 1930-31, with nine goals and two assists. Jaime Lazcano, with Real Madrid in 1928-29, and Victorio Unamuno, with Athletic in 1928-29, each reached 11 with eight goals and three assists.



With the season still in its early stages, Yamal and Raphinha are giving Barcelona a scoring edge that few teams in Europe can match. The question now is how far they can push these numbers over the rest of the campaign, and whether they can keep the club’s perfect start going.

items.title: Europe is a blast – but more a curse than a blessing if you are not a Premier League super-club I Jonathan Wilson
items.description: The four Premier League clubs playing in the lesser continental competitions face each other on Sunday – but three are struggling domesticallyThe sun shone. The temperature was in the high 20s. There was a mood of great conviviality. If you were struggling with the official allocation, it turned out you could just email the president of Torreense and he’d sort you out. Were these “Nuno-tickets” real? It turned out they were. Not only that, but you could sit anywhere you wanted in a stadium too big for the game and, if you happened to have gravitated to the comfortable hospitality seating at the back of the lower tier, the beer was inexplicably free.Locals in Leiria seemed bewildered but could hardly have been more accommodating. A beer pump had been installed outside a patisserie on the Praça Francisco Rodrigues Lobo, whose owner soon found fans happy to help stack empty barrels if that facilitated the free flow of Sagres. “There was a meeting at the town hall to explain these are not hooligans,” said the owner of a radical leftist flammkuchen restaurant between the square and the cathedral. “They told us the club comes from the labour movement and I found that very interesting.” And how had she found the fans? “Noisy, but with a quirky sense of humour.” Continue reading...

items.title: Erling Haaland sets Premier League record that even Cristiano Ronaldo could not match
items.description:
Erling Haaland reached 100 non-penalty Premier League goals in a record 139 appearances, a mark that Cristiano Ronaldo never reached with Manchester United. 
Erling Haaland continues to rewrite the Premier League record books, and the latest milestone puts him in a category of his own. The Manchester City striker has reached a mark that many of the competition’s greatest scorers never came close to, even those who spent years at the top.



According to Opta, Haaland scored his 100th non-penalty goal in the Premier League in just 139 appearances, the fastest any player has reached that figure in the history of the competition. The Norwegian forward reached the milestone in Manchester City’s 3-2 win over Ipswich Town, in which he scored a brace.



Phil Foden gave City the lead in the 19th minute before Daizen Maeda equalized shortly afterward, and Haaland put the hosts back in front with a header in the 34th minute. 



He added his second goal in the 69th minute after a pass from Iliman Ndiaye, and although Zian Flemming pulled one back from the penalty spot in the 90th minute, City held on for their seventh win in seven league matches.




100 – Erling Haaland netted his 100th non-penalty goal in the Premier League, taking just 139 appearances to do so, the fastest of any player in the competition’s history.Centurion. pic.twitter.com/aXQjGmYjGZ— OptaJoe (@OptaJoe) October 17, 2026




Cristiano Ronaldo, who scored 103 Premier League goals in 236 appearances across two spells at Manchester United, never reached that mark. Twenty-four of those goals came from penalties, which leaves the Portuguese forward with 79 non-penalty goals in the competition, 21 fewer than Haaland has now scored in just 139 appearances.


        


Erling Haaland’s relentless start to the season



Erling Haaland has been unstoppable since the start of the season. The Manchester City striker has scored 12 goals in 10 matches across all competitions, playing 853 minutes, which works out to a goal roughly every 71 minutes.



Eight of them have come in seven Premier League appearances, with the other four in just two matches in the Champions League, and City remain unbeaten in the league with seven wins in seven.



His form carried over into Europe, when he scored a brace in the 4-2 defeat to Paris Saint-Germain. With those goals, Haaland reached 61 Champions League goals in 60 appearances and became Manchester City’s all-time top scorer in the competition with 38, moving ahead of Sergio Aguero’s 36. Three days later, he reached his 100th non-penalty Premier League goal against Ipswich, adding to a start that shows no sign of slowing down.

items.title: Why is Frenkie de Jong not starting for Barcelona against Real Betis in 2026-27 LaLiga game?
items.description:
Frenkie de Jong is finally back in Barcelona’s squad after a long injury layoff, but he will begin the match against Real Betis on the bench. 
Frenkie de Jong is finally back in the Barcelona squad after a long injury layoff, but the Dutch midfielder will not be in the starting lineup as the Catalans look to extend their perfect start to the season with a trip to Seville.



De Jong is not starting for Barcelona against Real Betis in the LaLiga matchday nine fixture at La Cartuja , and will begin the match on the bench. He was named in Hansi Flick’s 23-man squad for the trip, which marks his first call-up of the season after recovering from a knee injury, according to the club.



The midfielder has yet to play a single minute this season, after suffering a serious knee problem at the World Cup. After making significant strides in his recovery during the week, he was medically cleared on Friday, and the coaching staff will ease him back into action rather than rush him into the starting XI, with the bench giving him a chance to build match rhythm.



His return is welcome news for Barcelona, who arrive at La Cartuja as LaLiga leaders with 24 out of a possible 24 points. Raphinha, who has missed two matches with a muscle problem, is also back in the squad for the first time since the recent international break. Betis, meanwhile, are enjoying the best start to a league campaign in their history.




𝐋𝐈𝐍𝐄 𝐔𝐏 ⚫️🟣#BetisBarça pic.twitter.com/oJKBryr2i1— FC Barcelona (@FCBarcelona) October 17, 2026




Lineups confirmed



Hansi Flick keeps De Jong on the bench and goes with Rodri and Pedri as the midfield pair, with Karim Adeyemi, Fermin Lopez and Lamine Yamal supporting Gabriel Jesus up front. Raphinha, who is also back from injury, is not in the starting XI either, and Joan Garcia starts in goal.


        


Barcelona confirmed lineup: Joan Garcia; Xavi Espart, Gerard Martin, Cubarsi, Kounde; Rodri, Pedri (C); Adeyemi, Fermin Lopez, Yamal; Gabriel Jesus.



Betis line up in a 4-2-3-1, with Hector Bellerin as captain and Giovani Lo Celso, Pablo Fornals and Abde Ezzalzouli supporting Cucho Hernandez up front.



Betis confirmed lineup: Valles; Bellerin (C), Llorente, Gomez, Garcia; Bernal, Ceballos; Fornals, Lo Celso, Ezzalzouli; Hernandez.

items.title: Why is Raphinha not starting today for Barcelona against Real Betis in 2026-27 La Liga game?
items.description:
The Brazilian winger has returned to the squad ahead of Saturday’s meeting in Seville, but his absence from the starting lineup has a specific explanation that could prove crucial to Barcelona’s ambitions over the coming days. 
Raphinha will begin Barcelona’s La Liga clash against Real Betis on the bench, leaving Hansi Flick with an important decision to make as the Spanish champions navigate a demanding stretch of fixtures. The Brazilian winger has returned to the squad ahead of Saturday’s meeting in Seville, but his absence from the starting lineup has a specific explanation that could prove crucial to Barcelona’s ambitions over the coming days.



Barcelona travels to the Estadio de La Cartuja on Saturday, October 17, looking to maintain its perfect start to the 2026-27 La Liga campaign. Flick’s side sits top of the table with 24 points from eight matches and arrives after a convincing 4-1 Champions League victory over Galatasaray.



Real Betis presents a serious challenge, however, with Manuel Pellegrini’s side sitting third on 19 points and enjoying an impressive run of form. The hosts have also beaten Real Madrid this season, making this one of Barcelona’s toughest domestic tests so far.



The Brazilian’s absence has not prevented Barcelona from maintaining its impressive momentum. The Catalan club defeated Getafe 3-0 before dismantling Galatasaray 4-1, scoring seven goals and conceding only once across the two matches.



📋 𝗢𝗡𝗖𝗘 𝗜𝗡𝗜𝗖𝗜𝗔𝗟 #BetisBarça pic.twitter.com/3bv2caybVB— FC Barcelona (@FCBarcelona_es) October 17, 2026 



Lamine Yamal has continued to lead the attacking charge, while Gabriel Jesus and other forward options have helped compensate for Raphinha’s absence. His return nevertheless provides Flick with another important weapon as the schedule becomes increasingly demanding.



Why Raphinha is not starting against Real Betis



The main reason for Raphinha’s absence from the starting XI is Barcelona’s decision to manage his recovery carefully following a right-thigh injury sustained while playing for Brazil against Australia on September 29. The problem forced him to miss the victories over Getafe and Galatasaray, interrupting an otherwise excellent start to his season.



Raphinha returned to full-team training shortly before the Betis match and was included in Barcelona’s travelling squad. However, Flick is unwilling to rush the winger straight back into a full match, particularly with several major fixtures approaching.



💬 Flick habla del estado de Raphinha: "Si le preguntas a él, estará listo desde el principio. Pero es paso a paso" pic.twitter.com/1jKGw0tP4a— Mundo Deportivo (@mundodeportivo) October 16, 2026 



“If you ask him, he will tell you he’s ready to start, but I have to take it step by step,” Flick explained. “He trained well with the group, but we still have many matches to play in the coming days and weeks, so we have to manage it. The good news is that he’ll be available.”



Flick has a bigger plan for the Brazilian



According to journalist Javier Miguel of AS, Flick plans to give Raphinha approximately 15–20 minutes against Betis, depending on how the match develops. The intention is to rebuild his match fitness gradually while preparing him for a potentially more important role in Barcelona’s upcoming Champions League encounter.



Welcome back, Raphinha 🤙 🇧🇷 pic.twitter.com/ZtFRgzp0CC— FC Barcelona (@FCBarcelona) October 15, 2026 



Barcelona travels to face Paris Saint-Germain on Tuesday, October 20, before meeting Real Madrid in El Clásico on October 25. Flick reportedly wants Raphinha ready to start against PSG, making Saturday’s limited involvement part of a broader workload-management strategy.

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo suffers setback as Kingsley Coman is reportedly sidelined for Al Nassr vs Neom
items.description:
Kingsley Coman is reportedly out for a week with a hamstring injury, ruling him out of Al Nassr’s league match against Neom. 
Cristiano Ronaldo’s Al Nassr have received an unwelcome piece of news just as the team prepare to return to Saudi Pro League action. A new injury has complicated Ange Postecoglou’s plans for the next fixture against Neom on Tuesday, October 20.



Kingsley Coman will be unavailable for Al Nassr’s next league match against Neom after being ruled out for a week of treatment and rehabilitation, according to Saudi sports outlet Arriyadiyah.



The French winger suffered a minor hamstring tear during the 3-1 win over Neftchi Fargona in the AFC Champions League Elite, a match in which he was forced off in the 13th minute. He began his recovery program the following day and is waiting to complete it before returning to group training.



The absence comes at a time when Al Nassr are right in the thick of the title race. They sit third in the Saudi Pro League with 19 points from eight matches, three behind leaders Al Qadsiah and two behind Al Hilal.




Tuesday is the target. Today is the work 🎯⚽️ pic.twitter.com/zEhYEV7fMm— AlNassr FC (@AlNassrFC_EN) October 15, 2026




Neom, their next opponent, are fifth with 16 points, so the match is an important one for both teams, as the result could either bring them closer to the title race or push them further away.


        


Coman is not the only absence for Al Nassr



It seems that Coman won’t be the only player missing for Al Nassr against Neom. Winger Abdulrahman Ghareeb is also ruled out as he continues his treatment and rehabilitation program for an ankle ligament injury. The Saudi winger has yet to feature this season, and he is aiming to regain full fitness to become available for selection by Postecoglou.



The situation could get even more complicated for Al Nassr, as two defenders are also doubtful for the match. Mohamed Simakan suffered a strong ankle bruise during the AFC Champions League Elite clash, while Nader Al-Sharari has a hamstring strain sustained in training on Oct. 14. Postecoglou’s staff are awaiting their medical results before deciding whether they will be available when training resumes on Sunday.

items.title: James McClean: ‘Wearing the poppy was just never going to happen’
items.description: The former Republic of Ireland international on growing up in a community  still reeling from the Troubles and the controversy that scarred his career“The perception of me is that, basically, I am a madman,” James McClean says calmly. “I’m outspoken. I’m a loudmouth. I’m very opinionated and I hate all things British. That’s from people who don’t know me. The reality is quite the opposite. I’m pretty boring. I go training, go home and switch off. A lot of my days are quite bland, quite basic.”McClean sounds as sane as he looks gaunt on a bleak Monday in Derry. He spent 14 years in English football and the fact that he is now at war with his own club, Derry City, can’t obscure the fact that he is the fifth-most-capped Republic of Ireland international, having played 103 times. “People define success in different ways,” he says, “but I’m the only footballer from the north of Ireland to win over 100 caps for Ireland. I played 150 Premier League games over five seasons, 800 professional games and won a lot of individual accolades. I count that as success and don’t look back with regrets.” Continue reading...

items.title: Neymar hails Lamine Yamal as ‘best in the world’ after Barcelona star’s stunning start to the season
items.description:
Neymar hailed Lamine Yamal as the “best in the world” on Instagram after the Barcelona star’s eight-goal, nine-assist start to the season. 
Lamine Yamal continues to collect praise from some of football’s biggest names, and the latest message came from a player who knows a thing or two about spectacular seasons. The Barcelona star’s stunning start to the campaign has sparked comparisons with some of the best individual performances of the past decade.



Neymar, now at Santos, shared a post on his Instagram stories comparing Yamal’s numbers with his own from the 2017/18 season at Paris Saint-Germain. He tagged the Spanish winger with a short caption that read “Best in the world”. The post ranks the best average performance ratings in the top leagues since the 2015/16 season.



According to the list, Yamal has the second-highest average rating of that period, with 8.61 in ten matches this season, in which he has scored eight goals and provided nine assists.



Neymar still leads the ranking with 8.81 from his 2017/18 campaign with PSG, when he scored 25 goals and added 16 assists in 27 appearances. The top five is completed by Lionel Messi, who appears three times with his La Liga seasons: 8.52 in 2018/19, 8.40 in 2017/18 and 8.39 in 2015/16.



Lamine Yamal reshared Neymar’s story on Instagram. (@lamineyamal)



Lamine Yamal and Raphinha lead Barcelona’s perfect start



Lamine Yamal has been the driving force behind Barcelona’s flawless start to the season. The winger has scored eight goals and provided nine assists in ten matches across all competitions, playing 851 minutes.


        


Raphinha has been just as decisive. The Brazilian forward has 14 goals and three assists in eight appearances. He missed Barcelona’s last two fixtures against Getafe and Galatasaray with thigh problems, but his numbers are still among the best in Europe.



Their form has helped Barcelona win all ten of their official matches this season, eight in LaLiga and two in the Champions League, scoring 43 goals and conceding nine. According to statistician Mister Chip, it is a historic mark for the Blaugrana, who had not opened a season with ten consecutive victories since the 1923-24 campaign, 102 years ago.



With the season still in its early stages, the question for Barcelona is how long they can sustain this level. Raphinha’s recovery from his thigh problem will be a key factor alongside Yamal’s hot start to the season, as Hansi Flick’s side looks to extend its perfect start in the matches ahead.

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo’s international future addressed as Portugal makes position clear after FPF chief speaks out
items.description:
Pedro Proenca's comments have offered an important indication of how the federation intends to handle the controversy surrounding its captain as the next international window approaches. 
Cristiano Ronaldo’s international future remains a major talking point following his recent dispute with Portugal head coach Jorge Jesus, with Portuguese Football Federation president Pedro Proenca addressing the situation during a visit to Madeira. His comments have offered an important indication of how the federation intends to handle the controversy surrounding its captain as the next international window approaches.



Speaking in Funchal, Ronaldo’s birthplace, Proença described the Al-Nassr forward as an extraordinary figure in Portuguese soccer while promoting the federation’s efforts to strengthen relationships with local communities. The visit coincided with the signing of a cooperation agreement involving the FPF, Funchal municipality and the Madeira Football Association.



“We are in the land of the greatest asset that Portuguese football has ever created: Cristiano Ronaldo, our captain,” Proenca said, via Record. He also stressed the importance of local involvement, adding, “We have repeatedly said that there is no football in Portugal without the movement of the municipalities.”



The meeting marked the FPF’s eighth decentralized board gathering and its first outside mainland Portugal. However, the timing also placed renewed attention on Ronaldo’s unresolved situation with the national team.



Pedro Proenca, Cristiano Ronaldo, and Jorge Jesus



Does Portugal want its captain back?



Proenca made the federation’s position considerably clearer when discussing Ronaldo’s potential return. The FPF wants the 41-year-old forward back in the national team as soon as possible, with the president indicating that the coach and the player share that desire, provided Ronaldo is fit to play.



“What we are witnessing at this moment is a desire, first from the Portuguese Football Federation (FPF), to have the captain back with us quickly,” Proenca explained. He added that the coach had also expressed a willingness to welcome Ronaldo back, while the captain himself had made clear that he wanted to continue representing Portugal.



The federation president also urged everyone involved to avoid escalating the disagreement further. “Therefore, having said that, this is the moment to appeal for calm and serenity. We are doing our job because the desire is collective,” he said.



Cristiano Ronaldo of Portugal walks to the bench as a substitute



November return remains possibility



Proenca’s latest remarks suggest that Portugal is keen to move forward rather than allow the dispute to overshadow its sporting ambitions. The November international window, which includes fixtures against Denmark and Wales, could provide an opportunity for Ronaldo to return if the disciplinary process and discussions between the parties allow it.



The president has emphasised that the federation’s objective is to find a solution through dialogue while respecting the relevant disciplinary procedures. Wanting Ronaldo back does not mean cancelling the investigation, and the final decision will depend on the outcome of that process.

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo’s Al Nassr find goalkeeper replacement as Nawaf Al-Aqidi faces surgery
items.description:
Cristiano Ronaldo’s Al Nassr have found a goalkeeper replacement in Abdulhadi Al-Alwan as Nawaf Al-Aqidi faces elbow surgery. 
Cristiano Ronaldo’s Al Nassr have taken action to strengthen one of their most sensitive positions. The injury to goalkeeper Nawaf Al-Aqidi has left the Saudi club with an unexpected hole in their squad, and the team have moved quickly to cover it.



Al Nassr announced that 20-year-old Abdulhadi Al-Alwan will serve as the team’s backup goalkeeper following the confirmed absence of Nawaf Al-Aqidi, who is expected to be out for at least two months. The young goalkeeper joins the first team’s goalkeeping group to provide cover while Al-Aqidi recovers.



Al-Alwan arrived from Al Fateh’s under-21 side on loan until the end of the current season, in a deal that gives Al Nassr priority to buy his contract before the campaign ends. 



The signing was initially intended to strengthen Al Nassr’s under-21 squad, but the agreement also allowed the club to consider using him with the first team this season.




Nawaf AlAqidi will undergo elbow surgery on Friday. Wishing you a speedy recovery, @Nalaqidi. Come back stronger 💛 pic.twitter.com/E2oMgQy1Q1— AlNassr FC (@AlNassrFC_EN) October 14, 2026




Al-Aqidi was injured in Saudi Arabia’s opening match of the Arabian Gulf Cup against Kuwait, a 1-0 win, and was ruled out of the national team’s squad after medical tests. Al Nassr confirmed that Al-Aqidi will undergo elbow surgery in London, a decision that makes it highly likely he will miss the Asian Cup, which begins in early 2027.


        


Al Nassr face a demanding schedule with Nawaf Al-Aqidi sidelined



Al Nassr will have to navigate a demanding stretch of the season without one of their goalkeepers, and the calendar leaves little room to adapt. The club still has 26 matches left in the Saudi Pro League, where they sit third with 19 points, three behind leaders Al Qadsiah, who have 22 points and one more game played, and two behind second-placed Al Hilal.



In the AFC Champions League Elite, Al Nassr are eighth in the West table with three points from two matches. That position would put them in the last qualifying place for the knockout stage, with six group-stage matches still to play.



They are also alive in the King’s Cup, where they have reached the Round of 16 and will face Al Kholood on Dec. 1. Bento remains the first-choice goalkeeper, but with the team competing on three fronts, having a reliable backup in goal is essential, which is where Al-Alwan comes in.

items.title: Inter Miami coach confirms Lionel Messi’s trip to Spain but says he’ll be available vs Red Bull New York
items.description:
Inter Miami coach Kily Gonzalez confirmed that Lionel Messi will travel to Spain for the Princess of Asturias Award but will be available against Red Bull New York. 
Lionel Messi’s schedule is about to get busy, with an important off-the-pitch commitment arriving as Inter Miami, who have already clinched a playoff spot, chase their second Supporters’ Shield after winning their first in 2024. The captain’s availability for the club’s next matches had been a topic of discussion, and his coach has now addressed it directly.



Inter Miami head coach Kily Gonzalez confirmed that Messi will travel to Oviedo, Spain, next week to receive the Princess of Asturias Award, and made clear that the trip will not keep him from playing against Red Bull New York on Oct. 24.



“Leo has the possibility, and I wouldn’t call it an advantage, but I said it the other day at the press conference, I want him to be well, he needs this, he’s going to be there, and I’m going to have him in the game too,” the coach said to the reporters.



The coach also stressed that the entire club supports the trip. “Obviously everyone at the club is totally in agreement with him going, because it’s a tremendously important award, not only for him but for his family,” Gonzalez explained. He added that Messi remains part of his plans for the match, saying the situation does not worry him at all.



Lionel Messi celebrates a goal for Inter Miami. (Getty Images)



The Princess of Asturias Award ceremony takes place on Oct. 23 at the Campoamor Theater in Oviedo, a day before Inter Miami travel to Harrison, New Jersey, to face Red Bull New York at Sports Illustrated Stadium.


        


Inter Miami chase another Supporters’ Shield title



Inter Miami set the all-time MLS points record when they won the Supporters’ Shield in 2024, and now they have five matches left to try to add another one. Standing in their way are Nashville SC, who hold a 14-point lead at the top, which leaves Messi’s team needing a perfect finish and some help to get there.



Miami’s schedule begins with road games against Atlanta United and Red Bull New York. They then return home to host FC Cincinnati before visiting the New England Revolution, and they close the regular season at home against Charlotte FC.



Nashville have 66 points from 29 matches, 14 more than Miami’s 52 after the same number of games. Even if Inter Miami win all five of their remaining matches and reach 67 points, the task of winning a second Supporters’ Shield looks nearly impossible, as Nashville would secure the title with just two more points.

items.title: Argentina begins post-Lionel Messi era as AFA confirms rivals for November window
items.description:
Argentina’s post-Lionel Messi chapter is taking shape. With the captain’s international career over, the national team is already looking ahead to its next fixtures, and the AFA has now settled the schedule for the November FIFA window. The AFA announced that Argentina will play two friendlies: Uruguay on Nov. 13 in Buenos Aires and Costa […] 
Argentina’s post-Lionel Messi chapter is taking shape. With the captain’s international career over, the national team is already looking ahead to its next fixtures, and the AFA has now settled the schedule for the November FIFA window.



The AFA announced that Argentina will play two friendlies: Uruguay on Nov. 13 in Buenos Aires and Costa Rica on Nov. 17 in Cordoba. The confirmation ends weeks of speculation about the opponents and the venues, as earlier reports had pointed to La Plata as the likely host city.



The two matches fit into the international window that runs from Nov. 9 to 17, after Argentina cancelled a planned tour of Asia. Playing both games at home keeps the team close to its fans, who will have the chance to see the first post-Messi squad on Argentine soil.



Messi announced his retirement from the national team on Aug. 31, after Argentina lost the 2026 World Cup final to Spain, and he finally played his farewell match on Oct. 6 against Benin. 




#SelecciónMayor La Albiceleste disputará dos amistosos en la próxima Fecha FIFA: el 13 de noviembre se medirá ante Uruguay en Buenos Aires, y el 17 hará lo propio frente a Costa Rica, en Córdoba. pic.twitter.com/iQKawX2MI1— 🇦🇷 Selección Argentina ⭐⭐⭐ (@Argentina) October 16, 2026




While Messi continues his career with Inter Miami, the Albiceleste now move forward without the player who led them to the 2022 World Cup, with Uruguay and Costa Rica as the first tests of a new era.


        


Argentina’s history against Uruguay and Costa Rica



Argentina lead the all-time series with Uruguay, with 91 wins, 45 draws and 58 losses in 194 matches, a rivalry that dates back to 1901 and includes the first World Cup final, which Uruguay won 4-2 in 1930. The most recent meeting went to the Albiceleste, who won 1-0 in Montevideo in World Cup qualifying on March 21, 2025.



Against Costa Rica, Argentina have never lost, with five wins and two draws in seven meetings since 1956. Their most recent clash was a 3-1 friendly win on March 26, 2024, and they also beat the Ticos 3-0 at the 2011 Copa America and 3-2 in a friendly in January 2010. The only draws came in 1960 and 2011, both 0-0.



Argentina now turn the page on the Messi era with two matches that offer a good test for the team, as they will face two opponents who represent a step up in quality compared with most of their last 10 or so friendlies.

items.title: Mohamed Salah achieves European record that neither Lionel Messi nor Cristiano Ronaldo reached
items.description:
Mohamed Salah has scored and assisted in 13 major European matches since 2017-18, a mark neither Lionel Messi nor Cristiano Ronaldo reached. 
Mohamed Salah keeps adding to his résumé after his move to Turkey. The Egyptian forward scored and assisted in Trabzonspor’s 4-2 Conference League win at KuPS. That performance added another match to a statistic that neither Lionel Messi nor Cristiano Ronaldo has matched in Europe since 2017-18.



According to statistics network Opta, Salah has both scored and assisted in 13 different major European matches since the 2017-18 season. The Egyptian forward has four more than any other player, which means neither Messi, Ronaldo nor anyone else has more than nine.



Salah set up Paul Onuachu for the opening goal in the third minute and then scored Trabzonspor’s second in the 44th, completing his 13th game with both a goal and an assist before halftime. It was a debut to remember in the Conference League, in the opening match of Trabzonspor’s league-phase campaign.



Salah arrived at Trabzonspor in August as a free agent after nine seasons at Liverpool, where he scored 257 goals in 442 appearances. He signed a two-year contract, and he has hit the ground running in the Super Lig as well, reaching 10 goal contributions in his first seven league games, a record start.




13 – Since the 2017-18 season, Mohamed Salah has both scored and assisted in 13 different major European matches – four more than any other player.Only. pic.twitter.com/Lw0D0XmaJM— OptaJoe (@OptaJoe) October 15, 2026




Ronaldo and Messi chase 1,000 career goals



Salah’s record is a reminder of how Messi and Cristiano Ronaldo have set the standard for individual production in the modern era, even in areas where neither reached the same mark. The two icons are still measured by the numbers they keep adding, and the next big milestone on the table is 1,000 career goals.


        


Ronaldo is the one closest to the finish line. With 981 career goals, the Portuguese forward sits just 19 short of the 1,000 mark, a number that once seemed unreachable. Messi, meanwhile, has 934 and needs 66 more, so the Argentine would have to keep up his scoring pace for a long time to get there.



Salah’s 13 matches with a goal and an assist show that he is still writing his own chapter, even as Messi and Ronaldo keep setting the benchmark. With Ronaldo closing in on 1,000 goals and Messi still adding to his total, the three forwards continue to push the limits of what was thought possible well into their 30s.

items.title: Lionel Messi reaches 1,180 career matches: How many has Cristiano Ronaldo played?
items.description:
Lionel Messi reached another milestone in Inter Miami’s 2-0 win over NYCFC, when he made his 1,180th official appearance of his career. It is a figure few players in the history of the sport have reached, and one that shows the longevity of a career that has now spanned more than two decades. Messi’s total […] 
Lionel Messi reached another milestone in Inter Miami’s 2-0 win over NYCFC, when he made his 1,180th official appearance of his career. It is a figure few players in the history of the sport have reached, and one that shows the longevity of a career that has now spanned more than two decades.



Messi’s total is spread across four teams: 778 matches for Barcelona, 75 for Paris Saint-Germain and 208 for Argentina, a tally that closed earlier this month when he retired from the national team with his farewell against Benin on Oct. 6. The rest of the appearances have come with Inter Miami, where he has remained a central figure while helping the team clinch a place in the 2026 MLS playoffs.



The natural point of comparison is Cristiano Ronaldo, whose career appearances put him well beyond that mark. The Portuguese forward has played 1,340 official matches, which leaves him 160 games ahead of Messi’s 1,180. Real Madrid account for 438 of those appearances, with 346 more for Manchester United, while the rest are split between Portugal (234), Al Nassr (157), Juventus (134) and Sporting (31).



The gap in matches has also been reflected in goals. Ronaldo has scored 981 times in his career, while Messi has 934, and both players continue to add to those totals at 41 and 39 years old respectively.




PLAYOFFS SECURED! ✅💗 ¡Vamos por más! 🔗 https://t.co/lJL2vYRDqD pic.twitter.com/8OORwZjawd— Inter Miami CF (@InterMiamiCF) October 15, 2026




Their paths now differ at the international level, with Messi already retired from Argentina and Ronaldo’s future with Portugal uncertain amid his dispute with Jorge Jesus, but at club level each remains active and focused on extending numbers that are already historic.


        


Inter Miami clinch playoff spot with win over NYCFC



Inter Miami wrapped up their playoff spot with a 2-0 win over NYCFC, and Messi was at the center of both goals. After Sergio Reguilon found him in midfield, he picked out Rodrigo De Paul, who curled a right-footed shot into the top left corner in first-half stoppage time. Germán Berterame sealed the result after an impressive collective move involving Messi, De Paul and Luis Suarez, finishing from close range.



Messi did not score, but his assist was enough to put Inter Miami through with six matchdays still to play. Dayne St. Clair preserved the clean sheet by saving a late penalty from Nicolas Fernandez in the final minute, his second straight shutout. The 14th win of the season lifted Inter Miami to 52 points, second in the Eastern Conference behind Nashville, who lead with 66 points.



Inter Miami now turn their attention to the final stretch of the regular season, starting with Atlanta United on Oct. 17 and Red Bull New York on Oct. 24. With the postseason secured, the focus shifts to finishing as high as possible in the East as they chase the Supporters’ Shield.

items.title: Argentina reportedly already has first opponent for November window after Lionel Messi’s retirement
items.description:
Costa Rica is reportedly set to be Argentina’s first opponent in the November window, the first since Lionel Messi’s retirement from the national team. 
Argentina reportedly already has its first opponent after the retirement of Lionel Messi from the national team. Costa Rica is expected to be one of the teams that Lionel Scaloni’s side faces during the November international window, although the Argentine Football Association has not announced anything yet and the information comes from outside the country.



According to Costa Rican journalist Kevin Jimenez, the Ticos have already lined up two games in November, to be played in South America, against Argentina and Ecuador. The report comes after Argentina’s plans changed, as a tour of Asia that would have included matches against Saudi Arabia and India has fallen through, leaving the AFA searching for new opponents.



Scaloni had already hinted at the limited options when speaking after the last window, which included matches against Bolivia, Burkina Faso and Benin, the farewell opponent for Messi at the Monumental on Oct. 6.



The coach explained that the teams still available in November were limited, and that while he would like to face powerful opponents, the calendar did not leave much room to choose. 




Costa Rica enfrentará a Argentina y Ecuador en los amistosos de noviembre, serán en Sudamérica 🇨🇷 pic.twitter.com/jkWuE9W9xa— Kevin Jiménez (@KevinJimenezCR) October 14, 2026




The window runs from Nov. 9 to Nov. 17, and Scaloni plans to use the matches to test variations and give young players a chance as he rebuilds a team that finished as runner-up at the 2026 World Cup.


        


Uruguay also emerges as a possible opponent



Costa Rica is not the only name in the discussion. Other reports point to Uruguay, coached by Diego Forlan, as another leading candidate, with matches in La Plata or La Bombonera and even a possible rematch in Montevideo, so the final schedule could still change.



Uruguay arrive at the window after completing a tour of Asia, where Forlan’s side beat South Korea and India but lost to Japan. A meeting with Argentina would be a demanding test for Scaloni, given the intensity that has historically defined the Southamerican rivalry, and it would also give the new generation a chance to prove itself in the first matches of the post-Messi era.

items.title: Lionel Messi’s Princess of Asturias Award trip could put his Inter Miami return vs Red Bull New York in doubt
items.description:
Lionel Messi’s trip to Spain for the Princess of Asturias Award could complicate his availability for Inter Miami’s match against Red Bull New York on Oct. 24. 
Lionel Messi is set to travel to Spain next week to receive the Princess of Asturias Award for Sports, and the trip could complicate his availability for Inter Miami’s visit to Red Bull New York on Oct. 24. 



The schedule is tight, with the awards ceremony in Oviedo taking place the day before the match, and although there is no indication that Messi will miss the game, the logistics leave his participation as a possibility to watch.



According to Inter Miami insider José Armando, Messi would arrive in Oviedo on Oct. 22 and take part in the afternoon in a meeting with people from the city, as part of the awards week program. The ceremony itself is scheduled for Oct. 23 at the Teatro Campoamor, where Messi will be honored as one of the most successful players in history.



That timeline leaves little room for the return trip. Inter Miami host Red Bull New York in Harrison, New Jersey, on Oct. 24 at 5:30 p.m. ET, less than a day after the ceremony in Spain, and the journey across the Atlantic could affect how Messi arrives for the match.



Lionel Messi celebrates a goal for Inter Miami. (Getty Images)



The situation comes at a favorable moment for Inter Miami, who clinched a spot in the MLS playoffs with a 2-0 win over NYCFC, a match in which Messi provided an assist. The result moved them to second in the Eastern Conference with 52 points, and the team still has the visit to Atlanta United on Oct. 17 before the match in New Jersey, so any decision on Messi’s workload will likely depend on how the next few days play out.


        


Ballon d’Or gala adds another variable



Another event on the calendar adds to the uncertainty. The Ballon d’Or gala takes place on Oct. 26 at the London Palladium, two days after the match in New Jersey, and although Messi’s attendance has not been confirmed, it is another factor in how he might manage his schedule.



If he decides to travel to London after the match, he would face a second long trip in less than a week, which could make Inter Miami more cautious about how many minutes to give him against Red Bull New York. The club has not commented on any plan for his workload, so for now the possibility remains speculative.



Between the award in Oviedo, the match against Red Bull New York and a possible trip to London for the Ballon d’Or gala, Messi faces one of the busiest weeks of his season, and Inter Miami will have to weigh his schedule against their push in the Eastern Conference. 



Nothing has been confirmed, and his declared intention is to return in time to play, but the decision on whether he starts, comes off the bench or sits out will likely come only once the trip is closer.

items.description:
Take a look at the projected lineups for RB Salzburg vs AC Milan in the 2026-27 UEFA Europa League. Salzburg host Milan in the Europa League with both sides looking to build on contrasting midweek results.
RB Salzburg come into this one off the back of a 1-0 win over Levski Sofia on September 17, and Danny Rohl’s side will look to carry that result into a tougher continental test.
AC Milan, meanwhile, are still digesting a 0-2 loss to Benfica on September 16, and Ruben Amorim needs a response from his group on the road.
As for Christian Pulisic, the forward is expected to start from the bench as AC Milan coach Ruben Amorin is set to rotate the lineup to rest starters and give more minutes to other players.
RB Salzburg confirmed lineup
Rohl sets Salzburg up in a 4-2-3-1, with Christian Fruchtl behind a back four of Schmid, Boma, Kratzig and Lainer. Kitano and Mazurek sit as the double pivot, screening for an attacking trio of Barry, Vertessen and Baidoo who support lone striker Tabakovic. The setup favors quick transitions through the wide areas, with Baidoo and Vertessen tasked with stretching Milan’s back line.
RB Salzburg confirmed starting XI (4-2-3-1): Christian Zawieschitzky, Dominik Robin Schmid, Kevin Boma, Leandro Morgalla, Valentin Zabransky, Sota Kitano, Bartosz Mazurek, Abubakr Barry, Haris Tabakovic, Edmund Baidoo, Jesper Lindstrom. Coach: Danny Rohl.
AC Milan confirmed lineup
Amorim lines Milan up in a 3-4-2-1, with Maignan behind a back three of Pavlovic, De Winter and Tomori. Pulisic and Bartesaghi operate as the wide outlets in a four-man midfield alongside Modric and Chukwueze, with Cisse and Musah pushed up to support Camarda at the point of the attack. Modric’s presence in the middle gives Milan control of possession, while Loftus-Cheek and Chukwueze provide the width to test Salzburg’s full backs.
AC Milan confirmed starting XI (3-4-2-1): Mike Maignan, Strahinja Pavlovic, Koni De Winter, Fikayo Tomori, Ruben Loftus-Cheek, Davide Bartesaghi, Adrien Rabiot, Omari Hutchinson, Ardon Jashari, Alphadjo Cisse, Francesco Camarda. Coach: Ruben Amorim.

items.title: Cristiano Ronaldo’s sister singles out the biggest obstacle to Portugal return and Jorge Jesus reconciliation in emotional statement
items.description:
Her latest comments have raised fresh questions about whether the Al-Nassr forward will return to the national team, as the disagreement threatens to leave a lasting mark on one of the most significant relationships in Portuguese soccer. 
Cristiano Ronaldo’s international future has become increasingly uncertain after his sister, Elma Aveiro, made an emotional statement about the ongoing dispute between the Portugal captain and head coach Jorge Jesus. Her latest comments have raised fresh questions about whether the Al-Nassr forward will return to the national team, as the disagreement threatens to leave a lasting mark on one of the most significant relationships in Portuguese soccer.



Speaking to reporters in Lisbon on Wednesday, Elma expressed sadness over the way her brother has been treated and questioned whether the situation could be resolved. Her remarks followed Ronaldo’s departure from Portugal’s training camp during the recent UEFA Nations League window, an incident that triggered disciplinary proceedings and intensified speculation about his international future.



Elma made it clear that the controversy has been difficult for her to watch, particularly given everything Ronaldo has achieved throughout his career. The Selecao captain has spent more than two decades representing his country, becoming its all-time leading goalscorer and helping it win the 2016 Euro and the 2019 UEFA Nations League.



“My position is one of sadness. Unfortunately, the Portuguese people forget what people do and what they have already achieved. Now, they think the present should be different,” Elma said.



“Je pense qu’il (Cristiano) ne veut plus rejouer pour la sélection. Il y a plus de chances qu’il ne revienne pas, que l’inverse.”— Elma Aveiro, sœur de CR7 pic.twitter.com/H10DMJfO2X— As Quinas 🇵🇹 (@AsQuinasOff) October 14, 2026



She also admitted that seeing her brother caught in the middle of the dispute had left her struggling to find the right words. “I was even left speechless because it’s complicated. It’s very complicated to see my brother go through this because, of all people, he was one of the least deserving of it.”



Elma reveals the biggest obstacle to reconciliation



When asked directly whether Ronaldo wanted to return to Portugal, Elma offered a pessimistic assessment that could worry supporters hoping for a swift resolution. “I don’t think so,” she replied when questioned about his desire to come back.



She subsequently expanded on her answer, suggesting that the dispute had reached an impasse because of the emotions involved on both sides. “I believe it’s more likely that he won’t than that he will. I think they’re both hurt. It’s a situation they experienced themselves, not me. I can only speak on behalf of my brother, and I think things are at a standstill at the moment. We’ll see how it turns out.”



Her most revealing comment came when the discussion turned to whether Ronaldo and Jesus could eventually make peace. “I don’t know. It’s very complicated. You know something? When you’ve been betrayed, it’s difficult to go back to how things were before.” Elma’s reference to betrayal highlights the central obstacle facing any potential reconciliation: rebuilding trust after a disagreement that has become public and deeply personal.



Elma Aveiro traz más notícias para os portugueses. pic.twitter.com/eE0Drt6kQx— Cabine Desportiva (@CabineSport) October 14, 2026



Will Ronaldo return to Portugal in November?



Despite the uncertainty surrounding Portugal, Elma offered reassurance about her brother’s condition and his return to club soccer. She confirmed that the 41-year-old was back playing for Al-Nassr and described his physical and mental state as good.



“He’s doing well and has already returned to playing with Al-Nassr. His physical condition is good, as is his mental state,” she explained. However, she acknowledged that the controversy has affected him to some extent, adding that her brother continues to overcome difficulties because “he’s a great man.”



Head coach Jorge Jesus interacts with Cristiano Ronaldo of Al Nassr. (Yasser Bakhsh/Getty Images)



Jesus has previously indicated that the door remains open for Ronaldo to return, emphasizing that the decision ultimately belongs to the player. The November international window, when Portugal is scheduled to face Denmark and Wales, could allow both sides to move forward.



However, Elma’s comments suggest that a return may require more than simply resolving the disciplinary matter. Ronaldo would need to decide whether he is ready to resume working under Jesus, while the coach and federation would need to find a way to restore confidence after the breakdown in their relationship.

items.title: La calidad de la uva define la vendimia en la Denominación de Origen Toro
items.description: La campaña de vendimia en la Denominación de Origen Toro llega a su fin con un balance positivo. Las 54 bodegas adscritas al Consejo Regulador han recibido aproximadamente 19,9 millones de kilos de uva, una cifra ligeramente inferior a los 21 millones de kilos que suele registrar habitualmente la zona. Sin embargo, el resultado ha superado las previsiones iniciales y se sitúa en niveles muy similares a los de la campaña anterior. «Pensábamos que la producción iba a ser alrededor de un 10% inferior a la del año pasado, pero finalmente la cifra será muy similar», explica Santiago Castro, ingeniero agrónomo y máster en Enología y Viticultura, que ocupa desde 2005 el cargo de director técnico del Consejo Regulador de la Denominación de Origen Toro.

items.title: Vinicius Junior speaks out on Endrick substitution in Real Madrid’s 4-3 Roma comeback
items.description:
The decisive turning point in Real Madrid's 4–3 comeback win over AS Roma occurred in the 58th minute at the Stadio Olimpico, when manager Jose Mourinho substituted Vinicius Junior and brought on 20-year-old Brazilian forward Endrick. 
Real Madrid were struggling against Roma in Matchday 2 of the 2026–27 UEFA Champions League, but the momentum shifted dramatically when Vinicius Junior came off the pitch for Endrick.



At the 58th minute of the match at the Stadio Olimpico, Real Madrid manager Jose Mourinho decided to substitute Vinicius Junior. The Brazilian was enduring a difficult outing, and the coach opted to inject fresh energy into the attack to reverse a 3–1 deficit.



Endrick entered the match and completely changed the dynamic for Los Blancos. The 20-year-old forward spearheaded the historic 4–3 comeback victory, earning Man of the Match honors despite playing only 32 minutes off the bench.



Vinicius Junior reflects on his performance and the Endrick substitution



Vinicius Junior is undeniably navigating one of the most challenging stretches of his career. However, he remains acutely aware that soccer is a team sport; despite being withdrawn early, he celebrated the collective result and praised Endrick’s decisive display.



Vinicius Jr. of Real Madrid.



“It was normal [to be unhappy with the change]. I want to play all minutes and help the team, but it’s not possible,” Vini said after the game. “Endrick came on and changed the match. He was the best player in the 2nd half. We hope he continues to develop, Carlos Espi too.”


        


Ever since missing out on the 2024 Ballon d’Or, Vinicius has struggled to recapture his top level. While the setback took a significant toll on him, the winger has pledged that he is working tirelessly to regain his confidence and return to his peak form.

items.title: Real Madrid stage historic 4-3 Champions League comeback over Roma with stunning late blitz
items.description:
Real Madrid reminded European soccer never to take them for granted, writing another unforgettable chapter in UEFA Champions League history with a sensational 4–3 comeback victory against AS Roma at the Stadio Olimpico. 
Trailing 3–1 with barely eight minutes remaining, Jose Mourinho’s side mounted a furious late blitz to leave Rome with a stunning 4–3 victory, marking another historic night for Real Madrid in the UEFA Champions League.



After a difficult opening hour, Real Madrid found themselves trailing 3–1 with less than ten minutes remaining. However, they scored three consecutive goals in rapid succession to secure all three points away from home.



The comeback began in the 82nd minute courtesy of Carlos Espi, followed by strikes from Endrick and Antonio Rudiger to stun Roma and snatch the victory away from the Italian hosts.



A Historic Night for Real Madrid



According to Spanish statistician MisterChip, Real Madrid’s comeback against Roma in the 2026–27 UEFA Champions League is the fastest away comeback by any team from two goals down in tournament history.



Federico Valverde of Real Madrid.



The record was previously held by Liverpool, who overturned a 2–0 deficit against Villarreal in May 2022 by scoring three goals in 12 minutes and 48 seconds to reach the final.   


        


This time, Real Madrid accomplished the feat in just 7 minutes and 43 seconds, shattering Liverpool’s previous mark. Beyond claiming the three points, they wrote yet another unforgettable chapter in a competition they know better than anyone.



A Breath of Fresh Air for Real Madrid



Facing a demanding fixture run, Real Madrid desperately needed this morale boost. The club will take on Sevilla and Barcelona next in La Liga—two high-stakes matchups that could significantly shape their domestic campaign.



The clash in Rome was anything but simple, and the Italian side proved it by keeping Real Madrid down 3–1 late into the second half. However, this thrilling comeback win provides precisely the momentum and breathing room Los Blancos need as they head into pivotal fixtures ahead.

items.title: Mourinho slams Spanish referees’ committee over Vinicius Junior’s four-match ban
items.description:
The Spanish Football Federation's (RFEF) Disciplinary Committee has officially handed Vinicius Junior a four-match domestic suspension, and Real Madrid coach Jose Mourinho believes the timing of the announcement was off. 
Vinicius Junior will officially miss El Clasico against Barcelona after the Spanish Football Federation’s (RFEF) Disciplinary Committee handed him a four-game suspension. Real Madrid manager Jose Mourinho reacted strongly to the news with critical remarks directed toward the governing body.



The announcement of Vini Jr.’s suspension arrived just before Real Madrid’s UEFA Champions League clash against Roma. The timing was openly questioned by Mourinho, who expressed frustration that such a verdict was publicized right before a major European fixture.



“Ask Spanish Refereeing Committee why they published the news about Vini’s ban minutes before he plays an important UCL game,” Mourinho said prior the game against the Italian club. “Real Madrid is a Spanish club, so why publish it now?”



The suspension was more severe than expected



Initial reports suggested that Vinicius Junior would face a two-game ban after pulling Nathan Saliba’s hair and arguing with the match officials.


        


However, the referee’s detailed report prompted a much harsher sanction, and the Brazilian winger was ultimately handed a four-game suspension. Consequently, his absence will extend well beyond just El Clasico.



Vinicius Junior of Real Madrid (2026)



Vinicius will be sidelined for upcoming La Liga fixtures against Sevilla, Barcelona, Racing de Santander, and Valencia. While Real Madrid are expected to appeal the ruling, it appears unlikely that the committee will reduce the penalty.



Vinicius Junior is facing a tough 2026–27 season



In the match against Villarreal, Vinicius appeared to have scored to put Real Madrid 2–0 ahead. However, a VAR review revealed his previous foul on Saliba, leading to the goal being disallowed and a straight red card being issued.



It has been an unfortunate series of events for Vini, who is experiencing one of his most challenging starts to a campaign in recent years. Nevertheless, this enforced break may offer him the opportunity to reset, regroup, and return with a renewed mentality for the remainder of the season.

items.description:
Kylian Mbappe scores in his 100th Champions League appearance to pass Raul and move into fifth place on the all-time list. 
Kylian Mbappe marked his 100th Champions League appearance with a goal at the Stadio Olimpico, and in doing so moved past Raul into fifth place on the competition’s all-time scoring list. The French forward equalized for Real Madrid against Roma in the first half, taking his career tally to 72 goals in the tournament.



The goal ended a tie with Raul at 71, which Mbappe had carried into the match, and it moves him alone into fifth. Only Cristiano Ronaldo, Lionel Messi, Robert Lewandowski and Karim Benzema have scored more in the competition.



His journey to the milestone started with Monaco in 2016-17, when he made his debut as a substitute against Bayer Leverkusen and scored his first goal in a 5-3 loss to Manchester City.



He has since scored in nearly half of his appearances, with four hat-tricks, 11 braces and a four-goal haul against Olympiacos in a 4-3 win. He also reached the 2020 final with Paris Saint-Germain, but the trophy remains the one piece missing from his career.




Champions League all-time top scorers:  1. Cristiano Ronaldo 2. Lionel Messi  3. Robert Lewandowski  4. Karim Benzema  5. Kylian Mbappé   #UCL pic.twitter.com/GFEMCW2jyr— UEFA Champions League (@ChampionsLeague) October 14, 2026




The strike also arrived at a useful moment for Mbappe, whose form had cooled in recent weeks after a strong start to the season. He had scored eight goals across LaLiga and the Champions League before the match, and his scoring touch has been under scrutiny at a Madrid side still searching for consistency under Jose Mourinho, who has defended him publicly.


        


Champions League all-time top scorers



With his goal in Rome, Mbappe sits alone in fifth place with 72 goals, one clear of Raul and behind only four players who have defined the competition’s scoring history. Ronaldo, Messi, Lewandowski and Benzema still hold the top four spots, while Harry Kane and Thomas Muller are tied for 10th after Kane’s brace against Viking.



PlayerGoalsCristiano Ronaldo141Lionel Messi129Robert Lewandowski109Karim Benzema90Kylian Mbappe72Raul71Erling Haaland61Ruud van Nistelrooy60Andriy Shevchenko59Thomas Muller57Harry Kane57



Mbappe’s recent goal is another step toward the very top of the Champions League scoring charts, but he still has a long way to go to catch Benzema, who sits 18 goals ahead in fourth. At 27, he has time to keep climbing, and his place on the list is already secure alongside the biggest names in the competition.

items.title: Why are Arda Guler and Bernardo Silva not starting for Real Madrid vs Roma in the 2026-27 Champions League?
items.description:
Arda Guler and Bernardo Silva start on the bench as José Mourinho keeps Vinícius, Diomande and Bellingham behind Mbappé in Rome. 
Arda Guler and Bernardo Silva are on the bench for Real Madrid’s Champions League clash against Roma, but the decision has nothing to do with an injury. José Mourinho, back at the Stadio Olimpico where he led Roma to Conference League glory in 2022, has opted for a more physical midfield, leaving the two creative players among the substitutes.



Both were eligible again after serving suspensions, but neither has had much of a role recently. Bernardo started three of Madrid’s first five LaLiga games, but he has played only 8 minutes in the league since Sept. 12, as Mourinho leaned on Aurélien Tchouaméni and Federico Valverde as his preferred midfield pairing.



Guler is also a victim of a crowded attack. Vinícius Júnior, Yan Diomande and Jude Bellingham start behind Kylian Mbappé, the same trio Mourinho has used in recent matches, and Diomande keeps his place after scoring his first goal for the club in the win over Villarreal.



Madrid have not been convincing since the international break. They edged past Villarreal in a tight game that ended with ten men and they sit six points behind Barcelona in LaLiga. They do arrive in Rome off a 2-1 home win over Inter in their league-phase opener.




📋✅ ¡Nuestro XI inicial! 🆚 @OfficialASRoma pic.twitter.com/5Hm3Ztb4dl— Real Madrid C.F. (@realmadrid) October 14, 2026




Mourinho has not given an official reason for the omissions, so the move reads as a tactical call for a tough away fixture. Güler and Bernardo remain options to change the game from the bench, particularly if Madrid need more control against Gian Piero Gasperini’s back three.


        


Lineups confirmed



Mourinho goes with a 4-2-3-1. Dean Huijsen drops to the bench, with Ibrahima Konaté and Antonio Rudiger forming the center-back pairing and Denzel Dumfries and Marc Cucurella at full-back in front of Thibaut Courtois.



Real Madrid confirmed lineup: Courtois; Dumfries, Konaté, Rudiger, Cucurella; Tchouaméni, Valverde; Diomande, Bellingham, Vinícius; Mbappé.



Roma line up in their usual 3-4-2-1 and are without goalkeeper Mile Svilar, who is out with a finger injury, so Pierluigi Gollini starts. Paulo Dybala and Matías Soulé play behind Donyell Malen, who is free to play in Europe because his red card against Como only carries a Serie A suspension.



Roma confirmed lineup: Gollini; Mancini, N’Dicka, Hermoso; Molina, De Roon, Koné, Wesley; Dybala, Soulé; Malen.
